questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements** **:**

I. All colour are small.

II. No small are big.

**Conclusion :**

I. All small are colour.

II. Some small are colour.

III. All big are colour.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The least possible Venn diagram is shown below according to the given information:

Statements :

I. All colours are small.

II. No small are big.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc15116fd31187337b05e2bdd4d6d0f2b9b96aae4c2a0cab9d97831d81dff2ba.png] 

Conclusion :

I. All small are colour → **Does not follow **→ As all colours are small and No small are big. So All small are colour is possible but not definitely followed.

II. Some small are colour → **F****ollow **→ As all colours are small and No small are big. So some small are colour is definitely followed.

III. All big are colour → **Does not follow **→ As all colours are small and No small are big. So all big are colour is not definitely followed.

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

All books are pencils.

Some pencils are pens.

All pens are erasers.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some erasers are pencils.

II. All pens are books.

III. Some erasers are pens.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The least possible Venn diagram is shown below according to the given information.

Statements :

All books are pencils.

Some pencils are pens.

All pens are erasers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9a6a1d11b3a6ca5c970616551691cc3b2debaf7bbe373f624e6f7906d0e1c0c.png] 

Conclusions :

I. Some erasers are pencils → **Follow **→ As all books are pencils and all pens are erasers. So some erasers are pencils is definitely followed.

II. All pens are books → **Does not follow **→ As all books are pencils, some pencils are pens and all pens are erasers. So all pens are books is not definitely followed.

III. Some erasers are pens → **Follow **→ As some pencils are pens and all pens are erasers. So some erasers are pens is definitely followed.

So, Only conclusions I and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question:
By interchanging the given two signs and numbers which of the following equation will be not correct?

÷ and ×, 1 and 3
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

We have to interchange the given signs and numbers so that the equation will be not correct.

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) **6 ÷ 3 - 1 + 4 × 2 = 5

After interchanging the signs and numbers we get the:

⇒ 6 × 1 - 3 + __**4 ÷ 2**__ = 5

⇒__** 6 × 1**__ - 3 + 2 = 5

⇒ __**6**__ - 3 __**+ 2**__ = 5

⇒ 8 - 3 = 5

⇒ 5 = 5 (Correct)

**Option 2) **4 × 3 - 1 + 8 ÷ 2 = 9

After interchanging the signs and numbers we get the:

⇒ __**4 ÷ 1**__ - 3 + 8 × 2 = 9

⇒ 4 - 3 + __**8 × 2**__ = 9

⇒ __**4**__ - 3 __**+ 16**__ = 9

⇒ 20 - 3 = 9

⇒ 17 ≠ 9 (Not correct)

**Option 3) **5 - 8 × 3 + 9 ÷ 1 = 24

After interchanging the signs and numbers we get the:

⇒ 5 - __**8 ÷ 1**__ + 9 × 3 = 24

⇒ 5 - 8 + __**9 × 3**__ = 24

⇒ __**5**__ - 8 __**+ 27**__ = 24

⇒ __**32 - 8**__ = 24

⇒ 24 = 24 (Correct)

**Option 4) **6 + 4 - 9 × 3 ÷ 1 = -17

After interchanging the signs and numbers we get the:

⇒ 6 + 4 - __**9 ÷ 1**__ × 3 = -17

⇒ 6 + 4 - __**9 × 3**__ = -17

⇒__** 6 + 4 **__- 27 = -17

⇒ __**10 - 27 **__= -17

⇒ -17 = -17 (Correct)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
